correctedCritiques.pro-deliberative-indispensability: Strongest feature: The analogy between explanatory inquiry and practical deliberation provides an affirmative route to normative ontology, presenting deliberation as a respectable project whose indispensable commitments merit ontological recognition rather than resting realism upon linguistic appearances. Principal limitation: The abbreviated electron comparison leaves the relevant indispensability insufficiently characterized and does not demonstrate why indispensability within practical reasoning warrants ontological commitment instead of project-internal usefulness. Live burden: The argument must establish parity between explanatory and deliberative indispensability while demonstrating that normative facts perform indispensable work unavailable to attitude-centered or deflationary alternatives. Locked score: The strong and competent band reflects central relevance and a constructive mechanism, moderated because the analogy's sufficiency claim remains stronger than its articulated justification.
correctedCritiques.pro-centrality-weighted-theory-cost: Strongest feature: The reply concedes the reflective anomaly and offers a comparative principle: explanatory awkwardness concerning exceptional cases can be less damaging than inability to capture foundational features of normative deliberation. Principal limitation: Centrality remains asserted rather than specified, while the response insufficiently addresses how a foundational anomaly might disclose a structural defect whose importance substantially exceeds its prevalence. Live burden: The weighting method must distinguish explanatory centrality from familiarity and demonstrate why rival-framework cases remain peripheral to the phenomenon realism purports to explain. Locked score: The very strong band recognizes central relevance, direct responsiveness, explicit concession, and proportionate calibration, while evidential and charitable limitations concern justification of comparative weights rather than the coherence of weighting theoretical costs.
